主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada updated its credit ratings information, noting that Fitch Ratings affirmed its ratings but changed the outlook to 'negative' from 'stable' on January 25, 2016. This update was included in the bank's 2015 Management’s Discussion and Analysis, which was previously filed as an exhibit to its Form 40-F dated December 2, 2015. The report was filed on January 26, 2016, as part of the SEC's Form 6-K filing. The bank's management and treasurer, James Salem, signed the report on behalf of the company.
